meta.name: Assurance Threshold - Three Hunters
meta.blurb: Three hunters choose stag or hare for ten rounds with private sheltered or exposed types; reach 38 to win.

rules: 3 players play {rounds} rounds. At start each player is privately dealt a type: Sheltered or Exposed, each 50% independent ({type_probability_sheltered}). Type is seen only by you and never revealed. Each round every player simultaneously chooses C (hunt stag / invest) or D (hunt hare / don't invest). Let n_C be number who chose C (0-3). Payoffs: If you chose C: you get {payoff_c_all_cooperate} if n_C==3, otherwise {payoff_c_sheltered_partial} if Sheltered and {payoff_c_exposed_partial} if Exposed. If you chose D: you get {payoff_d_lone_defector} if n_C==2 (lone defector), otherwise {payoff_d_other}. After the round each player is told n_C and their own payoff, but not who chose what. Totals accumulate. After {rounds} rounds every player whose cumulative total >= {win_threshold} wins. If one reaches threshold and others do not, that player is sole winner. If multiple reach threshold they share the win. If none reaches threshold, all three share the win. Higher total alone does not win unless it reaches {win_threshold}.

payoff_c_all_cooperate if $a1 == 'C' and n_c == 3 else (payoff_c_sheltered_partial if $a1 == 'C' and players[0].player_type == 'Sheltered' else (payoff_c_exposed_partial if $a1 == 'C' else (payoff_d_lone_defector if n_c == 2 else payoff_d_other)))

payoff_c_all_cooperate if $a2 == 'C' and n_c == 3 else (payoff_c_sheltered_partial if $a2 == 'C' and players[1].player_type == 'Sheltered' else (payoff_c_exposed_partial if $a2 == 'C' else (payoff_d_lone_defector if n_c == 2 else payoff_d_other)))

payoff_c_all_cooperate if $a3 == 'C' and n_c == 3 else (payoff_c_sheltered_partial if $a3 == 'C' and players[2].player_type == 'Sheltered' else (payoff_c_exposed_partial if $a3 == 'C' else (payoff_d_lone_defector if n_c == 2 else payoff_d_other)))

Final totals: Seat 1 {players[0].total_score}, Seat 2 {players[1].total_score}, Seat 3 {players[2].total_score}; threshold {win_threshold}, rounds {round_number}/{rounds}, last n_C {n_c}. {'No player reached threshold, so all share the win.' if count(p.total_score >= win_threshold for p in players) == 0 else 'Multiple players reached threshold.' if count(p.total_score >= win_threshold for p in players) > 1 else 'Only the winner reached threshold.'}
